info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Connect API
Channels
Salesforce Experience Cloud List CMS Channels

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

items.docs: Returns a list of CMS channels available to the context user. Channels represent destinations where managed content can be published, such as Experience Cloud sites or external applications.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get a CMS Channel

params.name: channelId
params.description: The ID of the CMS channel

items.docs: Returns details about a specific CMS channel including its name, type, domain, and the content types available in the channel.

info.name: Content
Salesforce Experience Cloud List CMS Contents

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

params.name: managedContentType
params.description: Filter by managed content type developer name

params.name: language
params.description: Language code to filter content (e.g., en_US)

params.name: channelId
params.description: Filter content by channel ID

params.name: folderId
params.description: Filter content by folder ID

items.docs: Returns a list of CMS content items. Supports filtering by content type, language, and channel. Returns content metadata and body fields.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Create CMS Content

items.docs: Creates a new CMS content item in the specified workspace. Requires the content type, title, and body fields defined for the content type.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get CMS Content

params.name: contentId
params.description: The ID of the CMS content item

params.name: language
params.description: Language variant to retrieve

items.docs: Returns a specific CMS content item by its ID, including all body fields, metadata, and version information.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Update CMS Content

params.name: contentId
params.description: The ID of the CMS content item

items.docs: Updates an existing CMS content item. Supports updating the title, body fields, and language variants.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Delete CMS Content

params.name: contentId
params.description: The ID of the CMS content item

items.docs: Deletes the specified CMS content item. Content that is currently published must be unpublished before deletion.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Publish CMS Content

params.name: contentId
params.description: The ID of the CMS content item

items.docs: Publishes the specified CMS content item to its assigned channels, making it available for delivery.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Unpublish CMS Content

params.name: contentId
params.description: The ID of the CMS content item

items.docs: Unpublishes the specified CMS content item, removing it from delivery channels.

info.name: Content Types
Salesforce Experience Cloud List Content Types

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

items.docs: Returns the CMS content types available in the org, including both standard and custom content types with their field definitions.

info.name: Folders
Salesforce Experience Cloud List CMS Folders

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

items.docs: Returns a list of CMS workspace folders used to organize content.

info.name: Media
Salesforce Experience Cloud List CMS Media

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (0-indexed)

params.name: folderId
params.description: Filter media by folder ID

items.docs: Returns a list of media files (images, documents) stored in the CMS workspace.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Upload CMS Media

items.docs: Uploads a media file (image, document, or video) to the CMS workspace.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get CMS Media

params.name: mediaId
params.description: The ID of the media file

items.docs: Returns metadata about a specific media file including its URL, dimensions, file type, and alt text.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Delete CMS Media

params.name: mediaId
params.description: The ID of the media file

items.docs: Deletes the specified media file from the CMS workspace.
